description: Create all 9 student dashboard section components in frontend/src/components/dashboard/student/. Each imports from career/ components (FEAT-001) and careerService.js. Depends on FEAT-001 being complete. Independent of FEAT-003.
steps: Create frontend/src/components/dashboard/student/SkillEvidenceHub.jsx. Imports: { api } from '../../../services/api'; { getSkillEvidence, getSkillEvidenceBreakdown, addSkillEvidence } from '../../../services/careerService'; SkillEvidenceCard from '../../career/SkillEvidenceCard'; { Skeleton } from '../../ui/Skeleton'; Button from '../../ui/Button'; Modal from '../../ui/Modal'; EmptyState from '../../ui/EmptyState'; { ShieldCheck, Plus } from 'lucide-react'; { useState, useEffect } from 'react'. State: evidence(array), breakdown(obj), loading(bool), showModal(bool), form({skillName:'', proficiency:'beginner', evidenceType:'resume', description:'', strength:'moderate'}), submitting(bool). On mount fetch both endpoints in parallel with Promise.all. Overall confidence summary: average confidenceScore across all evidence items, shown as a ConfidenceBar at top. Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4 of SkillEvidenceCard. 'Add Skill Evidence' button opens Modal. Modal form: skillName text input, proficiency select(beginner/intermediate/advanced/expert), evidenceType select(resume/project/internship/certificate/assessment/learning/interview/feedback), description textarea, strength select(weak/moderate/strong). Submit calls addSkillEvidence then refetches. Loading: 6 Skeleton divs h-32. Empty: EmptyState title='No Skill Evidence Yet' message='Add evidence to build your skill confidence profile'. Default export.

Create frontend/src/components/dashboard/student/SkillGapPriority.jsx. Imports: { getSkillGaps } from '../../../services/careerService'; SkillGapItem from '../../career/SkillGapItem'; WhatIfSimulator from '../../career/WhatIfSimulator'; { Skeleton } from '../../ui/Skeleton'; EmptyState from '../../ui/EmptyState'; { Target } from 'lucide-react'; { api } from '../../../services/api'. State: gaps(array), loading(bool). On mount fetch /api/career/skill-gaps. Pass a simulateHandler to WhatIfSimulator: async fn that calls api.post('/career/what-if', {skill}) and returns response. Render: header h1 'Skill Gap Priority Engine' + Target icon, WhatIfSimulator above the list, ranked list of SkillGapItem. Loading: 4 Skeleton h-20. Empty: EmptyState with encouraging message. Default export.

Create frontend/src/components/dashboard/student/CareerActionPlan.jsx. Imports: { getActionPlan, updateActionItem } from '../../../services/careerService'; { Skeleton } from '../../ui/Skeleton'; Button from '../../ui/Button'; EmptyState from '../../ui/EmptyState'; { Book, Code, FileText, Briefcase, Mic, RefreshCw, CheckCircle } from 'lucide-react'; { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; { motion } from 'framer-motion'; { toast } from 'react-hot-toast'. State: items(array), loading(bool). Icon map: {learning:Book, coding:Code, resume:FileText, apply:Briefcase, interview:Mic}. Each item: numbered card with icon, title, description, priority badge (high=red, medium=amber, low=green bg/text), estimated impact text, 'Mark Done' button that calls updateActionItem(item.id) then sets item.done=true in local state and shows toast 'Action marked done!'. Refresh button calls getActionPlan() again. Loading: 3 Skeleton h-24. Empty: EmptyState. Default export.

Create frontend/src/components/dashboard/student/InternshipReadiness.jsx. Imports: { getReadiness } from '../../../services/careerService'; ConfidenceBar from '../../career/ConfidenceBar'; { Skeleton } from '../../ui/Skeleton'; { Gauge } from 'lucide-react'. State: readiness(obj), loading(bool). On mount fetch. Large overall score display (text-5xl font-black, colored by score). Five ConfidenceBars labeled: Resume Readiness (readiness.resumeScore), Skills Coverage (readiness.skillsScore), Evidence Strength (readiness.evidenceScore), Application Quality (readiness.applicationScore), Interview Readiness (readiness.interviewScore). All scores treated as 0-100; if missing default to 0. Disclaimer text: 'This is an estimate based on your current profile data'. Loading: Skeleton layout. Default export.

Create frontend/src/components/dashboard/student/DigitalTwin.jsx. Imports: { getDigitalTwin } from '../../../services/careerService'; { Skeleton } from '../../ui/Skeleton'; Card from '../../ui/Card'; { Brain } from 'lucide-react'; { motion } from 'framer-motion'. State: twin(obj), loading(bool). On mount fetch. Subheader: 'An AI-generated analytical view of your career profile'. Six sections displayed as Card components: Current Skills (array chips), Confidence Map (key-value list), Target Roles (array chips), Strengths (array with CheckCircle2 icons), Weaknesses (array with AlertCircle icons), Opportunity Profile (text/object display). If a section is empty/missing, show a muted 'Not yet calculated' label. Read-only display only. Loading: 4 Skeleton h-32. Default export.

Create frontend/src/components/dashboard/student/CareerPathSimulator.jsx. Imports: { getCareerPaths } from '../../../services/careerService'; { Skeleton } from '../../ui/Skeleton'; Card from '../../ui/Card'; Modal from '../../ui/Modal'; ConfidenceBar from '../../career/ConfidenceBar'; { TrendingUp } from 'lucide-react'; { useState, useEffect } from 'react'. State: paths(array), loading(bool), selectedPath(obj|null), showDetail(bool). On mount fetch. Four path cards (or however many API returns, fallback to empty): each shows path name, required skills list, current coverage % as a ConfidenceBar, skill gap count badge. Click card → setSelectedPath + setShowDetail(true). Detail Modal shows: path name, all required skills with per-skill coverage ConfidenceBars, missing skills list, recommended next steps from API. Loading: 4 Skeleton h-40. Empty: EmptyState. Default export.

Create frontend/src/components/dashboard/student/DigitalPassport.jsx. Imports: { getSkillEvidence, getMyCertificates } from '../../../services/careerService'; { api } from '../../../services/api'; CertificateCard from '../../career/CertificateCard'; PassportSection from '../../career/PassportSection'; { Skeleton } from '../../ui/Skeleton'; { toast } from 'react-hot-toast'; { BookOpen, Shield, Briefcase, Award, Code, Star, Share2 } from 'lucide-react'; { useState, useEffect } from 'react'. State: activeTab('skills'|'internships'|'certificates'|'projects'|'assessments'|'achievements'), skillData(array), certData(array), loading(bool). Tab bar: six tabs. Skills tab: fetches getSkillEvidence() on mount, shows PassportSection with verified skill names. Certificates tab: fetches getMyCertificates() on mount (lazy — only fetch when tab is first activated), renders CertificateCard per certificate. Internships/Projects/Assessments/Achievements tabs: show PassportSection with emptyMessage 'Coming Soon'. 'Share Passport' button → toast.success('Coming Soon — passport sharing will be available soon!'). Privacy note: small text at bottom 'You control what is visible on your public profile'. Default export.

Create frontend/src/components/dashboard/student/ApplicationOutcomes.jsx. Imports: { api } from '../../../services/api'; { Skeleton } from '../../ui/Skeleton'; Button from '../../ui/Button'; EmptyState from '../../ui/EmptyState'; { TrendingUp, ClipboardList } from 'lucide-react'; { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; { toast } from 'react-hot-toast'. State: activeTab('record'|'patterns'), form({outcomeType:'Accepted', rejectionReason:'', notes:''}), submitting(bool), patterns(obj), interviewLearning(obj), patternsLoading(bool). Record tab: form with outcomeType select (Rejected/Accepted/Waitlisted/No Response), rejectionReason textarea shown only when outcomeType==='Rejected', notes textarea. Submit calls api.post('/outcomes', form) then toast.success and resets form. Pattern Analysis tab: on tab activation fetch api.get('/outcomes/patterns') and api.get('/outcomes/interview-learning') in parallel; show rejection patterns as labeled bars, suggested actions as checklist items, interview weak topics as chips, learning recommendations as list. Empty state for patterns: 'Apply to internships to see your outcome patterns'. Default export.

Create frontend/src/components/dashboard/student/CompanyFeedback.jsx. Imports: { api } from '../../../services/api'; ConfidenceBar from '../../career/ConfidenceBar'; { Skeleton } from '../../ui/Skeleton'; EmptyState from '../../ui/EmptyState'; { Star } from 'lucide-react'; { useState, useEffect } from 'react'. State: feedback(array), loading(bool). On mount fetch api.get('/internship-feedback/my'). For each feedback item: Card with overall rating prominently (text-4xl font-black text-saffron), six ConfidenceBars: Technical (feedback.technical*20), Communication (feedback.communication*20), Problem Solving (feedback.problemSolving*20), Teamwork (feedback.teamwork*20), Professionalism (feedback.professionalism*20), Learning Ability (feedback.learningAbility*20). Note: multiply 1-5 scale by 20 to convert to 0-100. Organization name + date header. Loading: 2 Skeleton h-48. Empty: EmptyState title='No Feedback Yet' message='Complete an internship to receive company feedback'. Default export.
